REFUND.summary: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery. A human approves every refund; agents may request information or offer store credit as alternatives.

BILLING.summary: Billing disputes may be raised within 60 days of the charge. Adjustments require human approval.

TECHNICAL.summary: Technical faults are investigated for 90 days after delivery. No monetary remedy is offered on this path.

ACCOUNT.summary: Account access issues are handled at any time within a year. No monetary remedy is offered on this path.
